tools.name: kanna_list_repos
tools.description: List repositories known to the running Kanna desktop server, including each repo's id, name, and local path.

tools.name: kanna_add_repo
tools.description: Register an existing local git repository with Kanna.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path to the local git repository to register.

params.name: name
params.description: Display name for the repository. Defaults to the directory name.

tools.name: kanna_list_recent_tasks
tools.description: List recent open Kanna tasks across all repositories, newest first.

tools.name: kanna_get_task
tools.description: Fetch one Kanna task's detail: stage, activity, branch, worktree path, blockers, latest stage-run result (latestRun), and the revision-round budget (revisionRounds, revisionLimit).

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_wait_task
tools.description: Block until a Kanna task finishes (agent stopped, activity 'unread') or closes, polling its detail. Returns the final task detail; times out with an error, in which case calling again keeps waiting.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: timeout_secs
params.description: Seconds to wait before returning a timeout error (clamped to at most 600).

params.name: poll_secs
params.description: Seconds between polls (minimum 1).

params.name: until
params.description: 'finished' resolves when the task's agent stops or the task closes; 'closed' resolves only when the task closes.

tools.name: kanna_task_logs
tools.description: Fetch recent agent-session log lines for a Kanna task, oldest first.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: tail
params.description: Maximum number of most-recent log lines to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: kanna_search_tasks
tools.description: Search open Kanna tasks by case-insensitive substring match against display name and prompt.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched (case-insensitive) against task display names and prompts.

tools.name: kanna_list_repo_tasks
tools.description: List Kanna tasks for a repository.

params.name: repo_id
params.description: Repository id from kanna_list_repos.

tools.name: kanna_create_task
tools.description: Create a new Kanna task: forks a worktree and starts the pipeline's first stage agent with the prompt. When called from a Kanna task session, repo_id defaults to the current task's repo. `agent` optionally names an agent definition (e.g. a specialty review agent) to run the task's first stage with, overriding the pipeline stage's own agent binding.

params.name: repo_id
params.description: Repository id from kanna_list_repos. Optional inside a Kanna task session, where it defaults to the current task's repo.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Task prompt given to the first stage's agent.

params.name: display_name
params.description: Short human-readable task title shown in the sidebar. Defaults to a name derived from the prompt.

params.name: pipeline_name
params.description: Pipeline to run (e.g. 'default', 'qa', 'specialty-review'). Defaults to the repo's configured pipeline.

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent definition name (e.g. a 'review-*' specialty agent) that runs the first stage instead of the stage's own agent binding.

params.name: base_ref
params.description: Git ref to fork the task's branch and worktree from. Defaults to the repo's default branch.

params.name: agent_provider
params.description: Agent provider id: 'claude', 'copilot', 'codex', 'opencode', or 'antigravity'. Defaults to the configured default provider.

params.name: agent_type
params.description: 'pty' runs the agent CLI in an interactive terminal session; 'agent' runs it headless via the SDK.

params.name: model
params.description: Model override passed to the agent CLI.

params.name: permission_mode
params.description: Permission mode passed to the agent CLI, in camelCase: 'dontAsk', 'acceptEdits', or 'default'.

params.name: parent_task_id
params.description: Existing task id to nest this task under as a subtask in the sidebar.

params.name: notify_task_id
params.description: Task id to notify when this task finishes: that task's terminal receives 'TASK <id> DONE [success|failure]: <title>' as input.

params.name: allowed_tools
params.description: Allow-listed tool names passed to the agent CLI.

params.name: blocker_task_ids
params.description: Task ids that must finish before this task; it shows as blocked until they do.

tools.name: kanna_signal_agent
tools.description: Find or create a singleton task for an agent in a repo and send it a message.

params.name: repo_id
params.description: Repository id from kanna_list_repos.

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent definition name to signal (e.g. 'merge-master').

params.name: message
params.description: Message delivered to the agent's terminal session as input.

tools.name: kanna_send_task_input
tools.description: Send input text to a running Kanna task's agent terminal session; a trailing Enter is added when needed so the agent submits it.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: input
params.description: Text to type into the task's agent terminal.

tools.name: kanna_close_task
tools.description: Close a Kanna task: kills its agent and shell sessions, snapshots dirty worktree state into local WIP commits, and removes its worktrees. Branches are kept. The task disappears from the sidebar.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_rename_task
tools.description: Rename an existing Kanna task by setting its display name.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: display_name
params.description: New short human-readable task title shown in the sidebar.

tools.name: kanna_advance_stage
tools.description: Advance a Kanna task to the next pipeline stage. If the current stage declares a post, the post prompt runs in the current agent session first and its success triggers the transition. A transition forks a fresh branch and worktree from the committed tip and starts the next stage's agent there; the task id stays the same. Advancing past the final stage closes the task.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_rerun_stage
tools.description: Rerun the current pipeline stage for a Kanna task in place: cancels the running stage run and starts a fresh agent session for the same stage in the same worktree.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_block_task
tools.description: Mark a Kanna task as blocked by one or more tasks. Blocked tasks show in the sidebar's blocked section until their blockers finish.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: blocker_task_ids
params.description: Task ids that must finish before the blocked task.

tools.name: kanna_unblock_task
tools.description: Remove all blockers from a Kanna task.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_set_task_parent
tools.description: Set or clear a Kanna task's parent task so it nests as a subtask in the sidebar. Omit parent_task_id to detach the task from its parent.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: parent_task_id
params.description: Task id to nest this task under. Omit to detach the task from its current parent.

tools.name: kanna_is_dependent_tasks_exist
tools.description: Check whether open Kanna tasks still depend on a task's branch before deleting its remote branch.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_complete_stage
tools.description: Record pipeline stage completion for the current stage run; success can trigger configured auto-advance, while failure stops advancement and surfaces the summary to the user.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: status
params.description: 'success' records the stage as complete and can trigger configured auto-advance; 'failure' records what blocked the stage and stops advancement.

params.name: summary
params.description: Short summary of what was accomplished, or on failure, what is blocking.

params.name: run_id
params.description: Immutable current stage-run id. kanna-mcp binds this to KANNA_STAGE_RUN_ID so a delayed verdict cannot complete a replacement run.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Optional structured result data (e.g. a review verdict) stored on the stage run and readable from the task detail's latestRun.

tools.name: kanna_request_revision
tools.description: Request a revision on a Kanna task: resumes the target stage's previous agent session in its existing worktree when Kanna has a supported provider handle, otherwise starts a fresh agent in a newly forked workspace. Kanna delivers the original task prompt alongside the revision prompt, so the prompt should focus on the required changes. Agent-requested revisions are budgeted per task: the response's revisionBudget reports rounds/limit, and once the budget is spent the request starts nothing and the task parks for its human (revisionBudget.exhausted) — report your findings and stop instead of retrying.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: target_stage
params.description: Pipeline stage whose agent should make the changes.

params.name: summary
params.description: Short summary of why the revision is needed, shown to the user.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Instructions for the revising agent. Kanna delivers the original task prompt alongside this, so describe only the required changes.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Optional structured data (e.g. review findings) stored on the revision request.
